question: What analogy illustrates how the designated being should be protected?
premises: A mother bears a child by a lover
She protects that child as her own son
This serves as a model of protection
inference: The being should be protected just as a mother protects a son born of a lover as her own.
uncertainties: The ritual or symbolic application of this analogy is not explicit in this verse
plain_english: Just as a mother protects a son born from a lover as her own son.
